verdict.rationale: Datadog's OpenTelemetry support suggests instrumentation can be re-pointed elsewhere, and a public API reference implies data can be retrieved programmatically. Neither entry is more than a title, though, and nothing describes bulk export of stored data in open formats or a documented offboarding path. Missing for 10: documented full-data export (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, monitors) in open formats, bulk or archive export tooling, a migration/offboarding guide, and independent hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
